body:
Coordinator checklist (Termal::Fable2) for the Engram sync window. Rev 12 condenses rev 11; see rev 11 for the history. Remove this memory once the window has been held on both hosts.

ACCEPTED: Greg accepted the cost and the rollback terms („tak jest OK", Asistant 588693a8 #1438, about 14:29Z): about 2 h of outage on Central. The cutover is ONE-WAY: the old build refuses repaired stores with different_build_schema, so rollback means restoring the pre-cutover DB plus WAL/SHM plus the old exe, and later writes are lost.

SEQUENCE per host, Central first, then DL560:
1. Greg stops TermAl.
2. The pinned block checks that no engram.exe or termal.exe is running, and stops rather than kills if one is.
3. Engram is installed and the old binary kept as backup. On DL560 the target is /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram, with expected old sha256 0c7d8988… (build ce3c7439); STOP if it differs.
4. doctor --repair-projections per store. Rehearsed on Central at about 102 min wall time.
5. Readiness.
6. Greg starts TermAl from the master checkout.

The Advisor "23:37Z" line is stale (from 11-11) and does not bound the window.

OPTION B (Engram::Fable #7663; my CONCUR #7664, about 14:40Z). This supersedes the 9c0b plan and Greg's md-only „Tak" (#1441, unused; withdrawn by Engram::Fable).
- The aacb1370 CODE lands: master is fast-forwarded to aacb1370, and the install binary is the rehearsed 98c9ec94, with no re-pin.
- C3 on w-4eabb205c7b2 is reworded to code-only: "…the code no longer implements or requires the linked-worktree sparse-checkout contract; bringing the remaining repository design docs in line is tracked by w-5f56184f72c1".
- The doc scope moves intact to the p0 item w-5f56184f72c1. It covers spec.md:614, git-task-sync.md:1024/1226, architecture.md:123-128, cross-host-task-sync.md:42/50/72-74, a repo-wide sweep, a link check and a pair, as a later Markdown-only changeset.
- The 9c0b FULL test-18be1591 is STOPPED through the launcher, recorded as withdrawn.

RESTART NOW via Advisor only when all of these hold:
(1) one re-evaluation on aacb1370 is 4/4;
(2) Engram master is fast-forwarded to aacb1370 and pushed;
(3) 12325's pinned command blocks have been checked by Engram::Fable;
(4) Opus2's drain is done by about 16:10Z.
The Central window is about 16:15-16:30Z. DL560 follows Central's readiness, in an Opus2 quiet slot. TermAl landing freeze until done: master stays e3970152, with no K3 S2b. If S2b had landed, older TermAl binaries would refuse the stores, which would then be restore-only.

IN THE RESTART NOTICE:
(a) The build hash and the reason.
(b) Ask Greg to COPY the TermAl startup console lines (state_load, subphase, listener bound, inventory complete) for w-4fad.
(c) The DL560 rollback exe is 0c7d8988…/ce3c7439.
(d) After DL560, OFFER (don't do) setting the TermAl project's Engram binaryPath on DL560 to /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram in the TermAl UI's Engram project settings. GET source-owner currently returns 409 "binaryPath is not configured" (src/engram_source_owner.rs:269-270), which blocks native registered runs and the K3 remote flow.
(e) Greg's DL560 cleanup list (w-d943694ed8d8, Opus2): about 48 GB of unregistered .tmp/r leftovers, about 21 GB of untagged targets (03d4 277b-2/3, c593 k3-1/2), and small residual dirs.

Evidence: DL560 Exception #17 PASS and closed. Central live readiness: 6/6 stores PASS. Windows: 127 tests plus the direct schema 33 (kind=test). Earlier evaluation 9fb3ca00: C1, C2 and C4 PASS, C3 FAIL on docs only.

UPDATE 15:01Z — the window is on HOLD (12325 #373, on Engram::Fable's word). The v1 operator package (.evidence/provisional/aacb-cutover-20261112, manifest 9607872a) pins DEBUG artifacts: Central 98c9ec94, DL560 dd80efd8. Those are not fit to install, and the ~102 min repair timing is a debug figure.

Replacement:
- exact AACB release builds: Central in root 3553 after evaluator 17647 ENDs, and s4 on DL560;
- a private refusal and readiness check;
- a private Engram+TermAl repair re-timing;
- a v2 package with new pins.

My #374 review found no blocking finding in the v1 LOGIC (guards, sequence, rollback, payloads). I reviewed v1 read-only and missed the debug class. For v2 I'll re-review only the delta (pins, paths, timings, the MCP-leftover text). Engram::Fable sets the new window and tells Greg.

The 16:10Z drain is suspended (Opus2 #5735). The TermAl landing freeze continues.

Notes for the restart notice:
- On Windows, child processes are not killed when TermAl stops. If the guard lists leftover engram MCP processes, Greg closes them and re-runs the paste.
- Freeze the artifact worktrees until both hosts are done.

UPDATE 15:02Z: the FREEZE is NARROWED. Engram::Fable concurred in #7668 with my #7667, and I relayed it to Opus2 in #5738.

While AACB is on HOLD, ordinary TermAl candidates may take their FULL and land; this covers combo72 and w-03b4 73f0fe27. The conditions:
(1) The freeze stays absolute for K3 S2b and any reader-floor raise.
(2) A landing may not change what TermAl expects from Engram, over the host protocol or MCP. Rolling back to the old Engram must still work with the started build. Opus2 confirms this per landing, with a one-line reason.
(3) The freeze returns at the new drain. The master at that point is final for the restart notice, and I send its hash to Engram::Fable.
(4) Placement yields to 12325's release builds (Central next on cargo; s4 on DL560) and to the clean Central re-time.

The new window is expected around 17:00-17:30Z; Engram::Fable confirms it.

UPDATE 15:35Z (Opus2 #5748):
- The w-4eab parent evaluation PASSED 4/4: native e2af549062724a0790bf69ad99153f85, Claude session-17653, rev 49, cut 10808, aacb1370/ba04. Restart condition (1) is MET.
- Release pins: Central b2fc71a9 (39366656 B); DL560 5b5ac67e (34660784 B, repair about 1 s).
- Still pending:
  - the Central private release re-time (test-4823b5b3, un-named timing checkout);
  - 12325's v2 package (I review only the delta from v1);
  - the Engram landing (fast-forward to aacb1370 and push);
  - Engram::Fable's new window and drain.
- The earlier evaluation failed because the root was rebound, tracked as w-36d0e270de9d. The 16-record cap is tracked as w-30b524c2bc6b.
- TermAl master is e3970152 for now. combo72 (w-03b4) may land under the narrowed rule if its FULL passes.

UPDATE 15:41Z: combo72 (w-03b4) LANDED. TermAl master = 73f0fe278402ee1ea5d653ff9549f11292fedf22, a fast-forward from e3970152 pushed at 15:40:33Z; Opus2 #5750 copied Engram::Fable. This is the master for the restart notice unless another ordinary landing happens before the new drain. The DL560 TermAl install is in progress. The Central install waits for the Engram re-time to END. Engram aacb1370 is landing (ff+push) now; its install comes in the window.

UPDATE 15:44Z: Engram aacb1370 LANDED (12325 #384), a fast-forward from 0bd70a30 pushed at 15:43:34Z. I verified it myself with git ls-remote: origin/master = aacb13707bc9. The author refs are deleted. No install yet: 0bd stays installed until the cutover. Restart conditions (1) evaluation 4/4 and (2) Engram landed are both MET.
Remaining:
- the Central release timing (test-4823);
- the v2 package, which I review as a delta;
- Engram::Fable's new window and drain;
- Opus2's drain census.
Then send "restart now" through Advisor, naming TermAl master 73f0fe27 (or later) and Engram aacb1370 with the release pins.
